integrity.unproved_extensions: No claims about nonreduced schemes or arbitrary local algebras

scientific_limitations: Only reduced determinantal rank loci are classified; scheme-theoretic multiplicities are not asserted.
Only fiber products of truncated one-variable polynomial rings, not arbitrary Artinian algebras.
Counts are of individual forms, not their isometry or homothety classes.
The rank proof is characteristic-independent; full historical novelty is not independently certified.
title: Linear rank-degeneracy arrangements for associative pairings on multi-branch Artin algebras
